name: Camp Buddy
source:
Camp Buddy is a Boys Love / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Keitaro Nagame in the summer scout-themed camp called 'Camp Buddy'.

At Camp Buddy, Keitaro, along with his childhood friend, meets his fellow campers, each of them having distinct personalities and stories to be told.

Keitaro has also yet to discover the divisions among the campers that threaten to close the camp down. It's up to Keitaro to unite the campers once again and make Camp Buddy a great place to be for everyone.

Help Keitaro with his decisions and create a special bond with your chosen partner. Take the chance and make the greatest memories!

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/mikkoukun]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Camp Buddy》是一部Boys Love / Yaoi视觉小说，讲述了长龟圭太郎在名为“Camp Buddy”的夏季童子军主题夏令营中的冒险经历。

在好友营，庆太郎和他儿时的朋友遇到了其他营员，他们每个人都有独特的个性和故事。

庆太郎还没有发现露营者之间的分歧，这些分歧可能导致营地关闭。Keitaro需要再次团结营员，让Camp Buddy成为适合每个人的好地方。

帮助庆太郎做出决定，并与你选择的合作伙伴建立特殊的联系。抓住机会，留下最美好的回忆！

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/mikkoukun]Patreon[/url]]
